facts.text: Serve the feast at Sophie's wedding party on the island.
facts.why: Sophie's wedding doesn't happen. She and Sky postpone it, and Donna and Sam marry on the spot instead.
facts.fix: Serve the feast when Donna and Sam marry on the island.

facts.text: Three possible fathers and one wedding. I'll fix the taverna, you bring the guests, and nobody mentions the diary.
facts.why: Donna doesn't say this. It is printed in quote marks. Her real lines include 'Somebody up there has got it in for me. I bet it's my mother.'

vibe.verdict: A sunny Greek taverna with the right food, but it leans on the setting more than on scenes people remember.
